scope: Additive same-day roster/elevation correction for all eight Week 8 early-window FINAL pairs. It preserves the complete paired candidate inventories in the parent evidence, adds newly assembled official club roster facts, and keeps every still-unresolved reserve/elevation fact explicit. It does not claim complete reserve coverage, does not infer an unelevated player from silence, and does not change any value, loss, carried rating, fair, prediction or customer publication.

parentEvidence.reuseRule: The parent file remains the complete paired candidate inventory. This file is an immutable additive delta and must be read with it; unchanged final-inactive, injury-candidate, QB, specialist, case and frozen-rating sections are not restaged.

globalBlockers.exactMissingFact: Official final NFL gamebooks for all eight early-window games are not yet posted in their game centers; exact participation, printed injury clocks, return status, quarterback relief and specialist use therefore cannot be reconciled.
globalBlockers.footballImpact: Whole-game and interval injury losses, replacement duties, QB effects and specialist effects cannot be calculated safely. Missing facts are not zero.
globalBlockers.requiredSourceOrMethodDecision: Ingest each official final gamebook when posted and bind the participation pages plus exact play/injury annotations before numerical validation.

globalBlockers.exactMissingFact: Complete season-to-date reserve/PUP/NFI inventories remain unassembled for every paired team; TEN, CIN, DAL, DET and TB also retain an explicit unresolved game-specific elevation/activation check.
globalBlockers.footballImpact: An unbound reserve player or same-day activation can change the eligible replacement chain, cluster allocation, quarterback backup or specialist inventory.
globalBlockers.requiredSourceOrMethodDecision: Bind the official club/NFL transaction record for each team without inferring completeness from silence; reuse every source-bound elevation above additively.

globalBlockers.exactMissingFact: Several replacements and role clusters still lack an eligible immutable source/value binding; an elevation proves roster eligibility, not a one-for-one role or value.
globalBlockers.footballImpact: Unsupported role/value assumptions would manufacture injury loss and contaminate carried ratings and future fairs.
globalBlockers.requiredSourceOrMethodDecision: Use only existing eligible frozen values, approved labelled estimates and disjoint duty allocations after participation evidence is bound.
